sections: A town address or a beach-side retreat?

Puducherry stays vary more than a photograph of a yellow facade suggests. Maison Perumal is a town-house option; Palais de Mahe has a different central address; Dune Ecovillage sits outside the same town setting. Compare the kind of day each location supports before looking at a room price. These are operator-source leads, not a ranking based on recent overnight inspections.
Maison Perumal: a small house on Perumal Koil Street

CGH Earth's factsheet places Maison Perumal on Perumal Koil Street and lists ten boutique rooms, including twin-sharing options. Its living page describes traditional house details and period furniture. Choose this lead if a smaller property and an urban neighbourhood interest you. Ask which room is available, whether stairs are involved and how quiet it is likely to be. A small room count alone does not guarantee privacy or silence.
Palais de Mahe: compare the actual address

CGH Earth gives Palais de Mahe's address as 4 Rue Bussy, also named Lal Bahadur Shastri Street. Do not assume the two CGH Earth properties have interchangeable room layouts or the same relationship to every attraction. Look at the actual route from the hotel to the promenade and the places you want to visit. Confirm the category, facilities and full quote directly rather than carrying Maison Perumal's facts across to this property.
Dune Ecovillage: a different location and pace

The operator identifies Dune Ecovillage & Spa at Pudhukuppam, via Pondicherry University, and describes a beach-side property with individually designed bungalows, restaurants and spa activities. This is a lead for a more property-led stay, not a central-town address. Its website also carries older retreat and promotional material, so do not treat every displayed offer or programme as current. Confirm your specific dates, bungalow, dining and transfer arrangements.
Room details matter more than the label

Before booking any of these, ask for bed configuration, air-conditioning, bathroom setup, access steps and extra-person policy. A heritage description does not establish accessibility; a beach description does not promise safe swimming. Confirm pool and spa operation separately if they matter to your plan. For an independent homestay, also establish who hosts, check-in arrangements and emergency support.
Compare the same total

Request taxes, meals, transfers, deposits and cancellation terms in one written quote. Check the actual map pin and allow for traffic rather than relying on a drive time in old marketing. Keep the town-based and property-based choices separate: a lower nightly price can become poor value if it adds transport every day.

sections: These stays are near Delhi, not in central Delhi

A resort weekend in Sohna or Manesar is a different plan from a hotel night in the capital. The Westin Sohna Resort & Spa and Heritage Village Resorts & Spa, Manesar are two named leads for comparing a pool-and-spa break. Both are in the wider Haryana side of the Delhi region. Establish the exact location and travel conditions before treating either as a short airport transfer.
The Westin Sohna: check the package, not just the pool photograph

Marriott lists a spa, fitness facilities, outdoor pool and dining at The Westin Sohna. Its overview also distinguishes rooms and villas and promotes a private-pool villa category. A private pool should not be assumed to come with an ordinary room. Ask about the exact category, operating facilities and what your package includes. A treatment, activity or meal shown elsewhere on the site may carry a separate charge.
Heritage Village Manesar: a haveli-style alternative

The operator describes Heritage Village Manesar with courtyards, landscaped grounds and Aruna Spa. Its wellness page lists treatments and facilities such as a pool and fitness centre, plus some scheduled weekend activities. This makes it another retreat lead, not proof that every activity runs on your dates. Ask which sessions need reservations and whether a day visit and an overnight stay have different access terms.
A spa is not a medical outcome

Choose a treatment for comfort and your own preferences, not a promise to cure stress or another condition. Tell the provider about relevant health conditions, pregnancy, allergies or injuries and seek appropriate medical advice where needed. Ask what the treatment involves, how long it lasts and whether any products or pressure techniques should be avoided. You may decline a treatment even when it is included in a package.
Build a restful schedule

Leave gaps between arrival, meals and a treatment rather than filling the weekend with activities. Check whether children, events or group bookings share the facilities. A large resort can be lively even when its marketing uses quiet language. If silence is essential, ask about the particular room location and scheduled events rather than relying on a photograph of an empty lawn.
Get the complete terms

Request a dated total covering room, taxes, food, treatments and transfers. Confirm cancellation deadlines and any treatment no-show charge. Driving times in hotel marketing are not traffic guarantees. These two operators were checked for published facilities, not live availability or a personally inspected wellness programme.
Two kinds of character

A small design-led guesthouse and a historic haveli offer different reasons to stay. In Jaipur, 28 Kothi and Samode Haveli give you two concrete starting points. Compare the room and location with your plans before deciding that a photogenic interior is enough. This is an operator-source comparison, not a recent overnight review.
28 Kothi: small scale and individual rooms

28 Kothi's own site describes a two-storey property with five rooms and communal areas. Its room page lists individually named choices, including Moon Stone. This is a lead for travellers drawn to a smaller design setting. Ask about your actual room, floor, bathroom and access steps. A five-room property may have a very different rhythm from a full-service hotel, so confirm meal service and staff availability rather than assuming them.
Samode Haveli: an old-city setting

Samode's official page places Samode Haveli in old Jaipur and describes courtyards, painted interiors and guided city walks arranged by its team. Choose it as a lead if the old-city setting is central to your visit. Confirm whether a walk is offered on your dates, how it is booked and what is included. Do not infer a specific room view, balcony or terrace access from photographs of shared spaces.
Ask about the unphotographed details

For either property, request the bed setup, room dimensions, air-conditioning, shower access and any stairs. Check the approach for a taxi and whether luggage help is available. A heritage building or a design feature can also mean an unusual layout. For limited mobility or young children, describe the practical requirement rather than asking only whether the property is family-friendly.
Make the quote comparable

Ask for a total with taxes, meals, extra beds and transfers, plus the cancellation deadline. Check whether an advertised restaurant or activity accepts non-residents separately from overnight guests. These are two named alternatives, not an exhaustive boutique-hotel list or a claim of available rooms. Choose the stay that supports your actual day in Jaipur.
Village stay or city base?

Goa's small stays are not all beach houses. Casa Menezes in Batim and Olaulim Backyards offer two inland or village-led directions to investigate. Choose one because you want its setting, not because every Goa booking is assumed to come with a quick walk to the sand. These are operator-source leads rather than live room recommendations.
Casa Menezes: a Batim village setting

Casa Menezes identifies itself as a heritage home stay in Batim, with a house overlooking paddy fields and village surroundings. This is a lead for travellers interested in a house-based stay and local landscape. Ask about the specific room, bathroom, meals and hosting arrangements. Do not assume a heritage home has the same late-night reception or facilities as a large resort.
Olaulim Backyards: rustic cottages and a creek-side setting

Olaulim Backyards describes rustic cottages, a creek setting and environmental practices such as conserving water and using solar hot water. Its stay page also lists a cafe and a Dive Bar associated with Great State Ale Brewery. Choose it only if that relaxed property setting suits your plans. Confirm your cottage's exact layout and comforts, and ask which spaces or activities are open during your dates.
Keep environmental claims specific

An operator's description of eco practices is useful information, not an independent certification of every part of the stay. Ask about air-conditioning, ventilation, insects, hot water and power backup if these matter to you. Rustic does not have one universal meaning. A creek nearby does not establish safe swimming, private access or an included water activity.
Account for every journey

Get the actual map pin and plan meals, beach trips and the return after dark. Ask about taxi arrangements before you need one. Do not rely on an older article's transport time or assume that a remote-looking photograph means there are no neighbours or events. A village-led stay is most rewarding when you allow time to be there.
Confirm the full booking terms

Request the total with taxes, meals, extra-person charges, deposits and cancellation terms. If dining or a bar is important, ask whether non-resident visitors and private events share those spaces. These two stays serve different preferences, and neither is promised available or suitable for every family.
A brewery visit and a bar evening are different plans

A production tour asks for an arranged time and a trip to the brewery. A bar visit is usually about where you want to spend an evening. In Goa, Maka's published brewery tour and the Dive Bar at Olaulim Backyards are two concrete leads, but they should not be treated as interchangeable stops on a spontaneous crawl.
Maka: investigate the brewery tour

Maka's official tour page describes its Latambarcem brewery, guided explanations of ingredients and production, and tasting options. The page also contains older pandemic-era wording, so verify that tours currently run and obtain the actual date, duration and inclusions before travelling. Do not rely on a displayed package price as a final current quote. Ask about footwear, age restrictions and what non-drinkers can do.
Olaulim Dive Bar: a different setting

Olaulim Backyards' stay page identifies an open-air Dive Bar associated with Great State Ale Brewery beside its cafe. This is a venue lead within a stay property, not evidence that outsiders can always walk in or that a production tour happens there. Confirm non-resident access, service hours, food and the beers available on your intended visit.
Choose the journey home first

Use a driver who will not drink, a confirmed taxi or another safe return arrangement. Do not let a limited tasting or a short journey become a reason to drive after drinking. Check the rules that apply to your age and the venue, and carry appropriate identification. You can choose a non-alcoholic drink or leave without explaining why.
Ask about the bill and the actual pour

Confirm serving size, price and any additional charge before ordering. A beer brand being made in Goa does not establish its availability at every bar. Menus and tap lists change. This is a two-lead planning guide, not an exhaustive ranking of Goa nightlife or a claim of a recent tasting visit.
sources: Olaulim Backyards: Dive Bar and cafe

sections: Keep the familiar cities, then widen the comparison

Hyderabad, Lucknow and Kolkata are useful starting points, but they do not describe all of India's biryani traditions. Keep this page as a way to ask better questions at the table rather than a recipe rule that every kitchen must follow. Tamil Nadu offers additional named styles worth looking for, especially when you are already travelling in the state.
Ask what is in this kitchen's version

Before ordering, ask which meat or vegetables are used, what rice the kitchen cooks with and how much is in a portion. A city label does not answer an allergy question or promise the same level of spice everywhere. Ask whether accompaniments are included and whether a bone-in serving is intended for one person or sharing.
Ambur: a Tamil Nadu lead

Tamil Nadu Tourism identifies Ambur biryani with seeraga samba rice and describes coriander, mint and curd among its flavour elements. Treat that as regional background, not a complete ingredient declaration for a restaurant dish. Ask the kitchen about the meat, dairy and side dishes before ordering.
Dindigul: a different regional comparison

The same state tourism page identifies Dindigul biryani with jeera samba rice, pepper and green chilli, and describes a distinct tangy character. This adds a concrete subject beyond the three better-known city comparisons. It does not mean every restaurant using the Dindigul name follows one identical recipe. Ask what is being cooked that day and how it is served.
Chettinad and Rawther styles

Tamil Nadu Tourism also describes Chettinad biryani and Rawther biryani associated with Coimbatore and the Palakkad region. These are further regional leads, not a claim that their recipes are fixed or interchangeable. If you are exploring differences, try smaller portions on different days rather than ordering more food than you can enjoy at one meal.
A regional sampler, not a national inventory

These Tamil Nadu leads do not make the page a complete guide to India's regional biryanis. A different place or community may have a tradition not discussed here. Do not assume that the closest familiar city label explains it. Ask the cook what distinguishes the dish, and keep recipe history separate from the ingredient checks needed for your own meal.
sources: Tamil Nadu Tourism: regional biryani styles
